app.title: Project Seven Seas
app.tagline: Build one ship, raise a crew, and become the strongest captain on the seven seas.
lang.note: You can change the language later from System. The game restarts to apply it; saves are shared between languages.
nav.label: Main navigation
status.ledger_hint: Gold and materials earned on this voyage. They are banked when you dock at a port; a defeat loses 25% of them.
title.footer: Offline game · progress is saved in this browser · all art is generated in code
title.strongest: Strongest Captain of the Seven Seas
confirm.return_body: Sail straight back to {location}. It costs no food, gold, or stamina and takes 12 hours. Your unbanked {gold} gold and {materials} materials are banked on arrival.
warn.confirm_unreachable: {n} optional facilities cannot be reached and will not work on this voyage. Depart anyway?
warn.facility_unreachable: Not connected to the walkway on deck {deck}.
home.stamina_rule: Optional challenges cost stamina. Sailing, forced fights, retreating, cleared rooms, and returning to port are free. Only food rations and supplies restore stamina.
home.over_capacity: More crew than berths. Build or upgrade Crew Quarters before departing.
home.aid_available: Free emergency aid is available at this port.
home.emergency_hint: Always available: return to your last safe port for free.
obj.target_hidden: Target: an uncharted location — explore to reveal it
obj.trial_locked: Captain trial at {location} opens after the main arc. Rival: {rival}.
obj.postgame: You hold the title. Legendary challenges are open in the late seas.
ship.edit_port_only: Layout can only be edited at a port
ship.build_hint: Click a free cell to place {facility}. Press R to rotate.
ship.move_hint: Click a free cell to move {facility}.
ship.stair_hint: Click a free cell to place a stair between decks {a} and {b}.
ship.select_hint: Select a facility, door, or stair on the deck plan.
ship.disabled_effect: It has no effect until it is connected again.
ship.damaged_effect: Damaged: works at half effect until repaired.
ship.stow_hint: Store it in the hold. Stowed facilities keep their level but have no effect.
ship.refund: You get back {gold} gold and {materials} materials.
ship.bulkhead_info: Bulkhead wall on deck {deck}, row {y}. Add a door to walk through it.
ship.door_info: Door in the bulkhead on deck {deck}, row {y}.
ship.presets_hint: Save the current layout and restore it later. Applying a preset only moves facilities you own.
ship.hull_confirm_body: Facilities are moved to the hold and can be placed again on the larger decks. Crew, cargo, and progress carry over.
ship.damage_penalty: Heavy damage: departures cost extra food until repaired.
ship.production_hint: Galley turns gold into food and the Workshop turns materials into supplies, even at sea.
crew.title: Crew
crew.formation_hint: Six battle slots: two front, two center, two rear. Lanes decide who gets hit first.
crew.tactics_hint: Used when an encounter starts. You can change them any time in the battle pause menu.
crew.dismiss_body: They leave the crew for good. Their equipment returns to the hold.
crew.legacy_hint: Choose up to two passives from classes this sailor mastered (mastery {n}).
crew.respec_rule: Changing class keeps level, mastery, and qualifications. Only the current class grants active skills.
crew.respec_body: Equipment the new class cannot use is moved to the hold.
map.title: Sea Chart
map.region_locked_hint: Win the previous sea's captain trial to open this sea.
map.select_hint: Select a revealed location on the chart to plan a voyage.
map.emergency_hint: Emergency Return takes you to your last safe port for free, even with no food or gold.
route.no_return: No known port to return to
route.return_warning: After this leg you may not have enough food to sail back. Emergency Return is always free.
route.fast_hint: Fast travel works between visited ports on a charted route and skips sea events.
site.title: Explore {location}
site.move_free: Cleared rooms are free to cross.
site.repeat_hint: Optional repeat battle for extra rewards.
site.stamina_rule: Entering a new room costs stamina. Cleared rooms, retreating, and leaving are free.
legend.title: Legend of {region}
port.title: Port
port.not_docked_hint: Sail to a port to trade, recruit, and invest. Your last safe port is {location}.
port.invest_hint: Each level permanently unlocks the listed service at this port.
port.food_rule: Food is charged once when you depart and is never refunded.
port.specialty_rule: Specialties are used for quests, contracts, crafting, and egg recipes. Selling far from home pays more.
port.no_equipment: No equipment on sale at this market level.
port.tavern_hint: New sailors arrive on day {day}. Tavern level {level}.
port.no_recipes: No recipes known. Recipes come from side quests and bosses.
port.no_side: No side quests at this port.
port.contract_hint: Contracts rotate every three days. Up to three can be active.
port.aid_hint: Free help when you cannot afford the basics. You can always recover.
port.dock_work_hint: Crew take a shift on the docks. Takes 4 hours, costs nothing.
port.dock_work_locked: Dock work is only offered when you are short on gold.
port.recovery_room: Recovery Room: {n} free treatments left today
port.wait_hint: Pass time to rotate taverns and contracts.
pets.title: Pet Lab
pets.no_eggs_hint: Eggs come from secret rooms, island hollows, side quests, and port markets (level 3).
pets.feed_rule: Feed up to three ingredients or specialties in order. The same egg with the same order always hatches the same pet.
pets.signature_hint: Find this family's clue to learn its recipe signatures.
pets.helper_half: Not a helper by nature: works at half effect.
pets.evolve_hint: Needs a Pet Lab and pet level {level}.
pets.evolved_note: Evolution is permanent and keeps every assignment.
codex.title: Codex
codex.classes_hint: Classes appear once a crew member trains in them.
codex.hatch_hint: Every hatch is recorded: the same family and input order give the same pet.
system.title: System
system.storage_memory_hint: This browser blocks local storage, so saves last only until the page closes. Export a save file to keep progress.
system.manual_hint: Manual slots are only written when you choose to.
system.overwrite_body: Slot {n} will be replaced with your current game.
system.load_body: Unsaved progress since your last autosave will be lost.
system.load_recovery_body: Load this recovery save? Newer progress stays in the other recovery slots.
system.recovery_hint: The game keeps the {n} most recent automatic saves: at ports, after battles, trials, and hull upgrades.
system.transfer_hint: Save files are plain JSON and work in either language.
system.import_body: Your current game is replaced. Recovery saves keep the previous state.
system.language_hint: Changing the language restarts the game. Saves are not affected.
system.restart_body: Your game is saved, then the game restarts in {lang}.
system.new_body: Your current game stays in its manual slots, but recovery saves are cleared.
system.shortcuts_list: 1–8 switch views · In battle: Space/P pause, 1/2/4 speed, R retreat, S skip, Enter continue · Ship editor: R rotate, Esc cancel
battle.skip_hint: Resolve the rest of the battle instantly with the current tactics.
battle.retreat_hint: The crew needs {n}s to withdraw. Retreating is free but forfeits rewards.
battle.ev_encore: The legend rises again for an encore!
battle.result_error: The battle could not be resolved. Your game was not changed.
battle.r_ledger: Gold and materials go to the unbanked ledger until you dock.
battle.retreat_result: You withdrew safely. Nothing was lost and no stamina was spent.
battle.defeat_result: Lost {gold} unbanked gold and {materials} materials. The crew was carried back to {location}.
battle.defeat_keep: Levels, mastery, equipment, pets, and charts are never lost.
sea.pirate.title: Pirate raid
sea.pirate.desc: Black sails close in across {region}. They mean to board.
sea.monster.title: Sea monster
sea.monster.desc: Something huge rises from the waters of {region}.
sea.cache.title: Floating cache
sea.cache.desc: A sealed crate bobs in the swell of {region}.
sea.vessel.title: Stranded vessel
sea.vessel.desc: A small crew from {region} signals for help.
sea.vessel.effect: Helping costs 2 food and earns gold and goodwill.
sea.shortcut.title: Hidden current
sea.shortcut.desc: Your navigator spots a fast current through {region}.
sea.shortcut.effect: Routes in this sea cost 1 less food; an uncharted place may be revealed.
sea.weather.title: Squall
sea.weather.effect: Without a Navigator or Barricade Room, the hull takes damage and you lose 2 hours.
sea.inspection.title: Pennant inspection
sea.inspection.desc: A patrol flying red pennants hails you in {region}.
sea.inspection.effect: Pay {n} gold, or refuse and lose 6 hours.
sea.clue.title: Message in a bottle
sea.clue.desc: A bottle drifts by with a note about the creatures of {region}.
sea.clue.effect: You may learn a pet family clue.
err.unknown: That cannot be done right now.
err.internal: Something went wrong. Your game was not changed.
err.no_encounter: There is no battle in progress.
err.no_event: There is no sea event to resolve.
err.need_port: Only possible while docked at a port.
err.not_revealed: That location is not charted yet.
err.not_at_site: You are not at that location.
err.trial_locked: The captain trial opens after the main arc.
err.fast_not_visited: Fast travel needs both ports visited.
err.fast_not_charted: This route is not charted yet.
err.no_food_route: Not enough food for this route.
err.empty_formation: Put at least one crew member in the formation.
err.need_infirmary: Needs an Infirmary aboard or a port.
err.need_workshop: Needs a Workshop aboard or a port workshop.
err.cannot_demolish_cabin: The Captain's Cabin cannot be dismantled.
err.hull_owned: You already have this hull or a better one.
err.hull_previous: Upgrade to the previous hull first.
err.last_crew: You cannot dismiss your last crew member.
err.pet_owner: That crew member is not in the formation.
err.hatch_inputs: Feed the egg between one and three inputs.
err.postgame_only: Available after you hold the title.
err.save_write_failed: The game could not be saved. Free some storage or export your save.
err.save_corrupt: This save is damaged and cannot be loaded.
err.save_newer: This save comes from a newer version.
err.save_old: This save is from an unsupported version.
log.new_game: You take command of a small ship at Brightquay.
log.equip_overflow: No room for {item}; sold it for {n} gold.
log.food_overflow: {n} food did not fit in the pantry.
log.supply_overflow: {n} supplies did not fit in the hold.
log.pet_found_secret: Your explorer pet found a secret place.
log.postgame: You are now the Strongest Captain of the Seven Seas.
skill.cond_critical: only when an ally is below 35% HP

region.dawnwater.name: Dawnwater Shallows
region.dawnwater.desc: Warm, calm waters where new captains learn the ropes.
arc.dawnwater.title: The Gull's Wager
arc.dawnwater.0: Gull raiders have taken Gull Rock. Clear them out and the harbor will take you seriously.
arc.dawnwater.1: Word of your win reaches Saltmarsh Landing. Sail there and meet the dockmasters.
arc.dawnwater.2: Something stirs in the Brine Cellars beneath the old lookout. Clear the cellars.
arc.dawnwater.3: Brightquay needs Saltleaf Grain to restock after the raids. Bring it home.
arc.dawnwater.4: Captain Mira Gull waits at the Trial Ring. Win her wager and the next sea opens.
region.emberreach.name: Emberreach
region.emberreach.desc: Volcanic isles of forges and smoke, where decks catch fire.
arc.emberreach.title: Fire Beneath the Keel
arc.emberreach.0: Imps swarm Basalt Isle. Clear the island so the forges can breathe.
arc.emberreach.1: Ashfall Harbor has gone quiet. Sail there and find out why.
arc.emberreach.2: The Forge Depths are erupting with golems. Clear them.
arc.emberreach.3: Cinderport needs Ember Ore to relight its great forge.
arc.emberreach.4: Flint Cinder holds the Crucible. Beat him in the captain trial.
region.verdant_maw.name: Verdant Maw
region.verdant_maw.desc: A jungle sea of spores and roots that drains the unwary.
arc.verdant_maw.title: The Rooted Shrine
arc.verdant_maw.0: Vine stalkers hold Tanglewood Isle. Clear a path.
arc.verdant_maw.1: Fernwater Post sends a call for help. Answer it.
arc.verdant_maw.2: Roots are choking the Thornroot Caves. Cut them back.
arc.verdant_maw.3: Rootharbor needs Verdant Resin to seal its hulls.
arc.verdant_maw.4: Rook Fern waits in the Verdant Arena. Prove yourself.
region.glass_current.name: Glass Current
region.glass_current.desc: Crystal reefs that dazzle the eye and hide decoys.
arc.glass_current.title: Mirror, Mirror
arc.glass_current.0: Shard fencers guard Lens Isle. Clear them.
arc.glass_current.1: Mirrorbay's lights have dimmed. Visit the harbor.
arc.glass_current.2: The Refraction Maze bends light and sense. Clear it.
arc.glass_current.3: Prismhaven needs Prism Quartz for its lighthouse.
arc.glass_current.4: Selene Prism awaits at the Prism Court. Shatter her illusions.
region.crown_shoals.name: Crown Shoals
region.crown_shoals.desc: Rich shoals ruled by old families and their mixed retinues.
arc.crown_shoals.title: The Lost Charter
arc.crown_shoals.0: Cutpurses run Heron Isle. Clear them out.
arc.crown_shoals.1: The Silkmarket guilds want a word. Visit them.
arc.crown_shoals.2: An old family crypt hides the stolen charter. Clear it.
arc.crown_shoals.3: Crownport needs Crown Silk for the charter ceremony.
arc.crown_shoals.4: Cassian Crest challenges you at the Crown Tourney.
region.stormbelt.name: Stormbelt
region.stormbelt.desc: A band of endless storms where lightning finds every mast.
arc.stormbelt.title: Eye of the Gale
arc.stormbelt.0: Squall runners raid Squall Isle. Clear it.
arc.stormbelt.1: Beacon Rest has lost its light. Sail there.
arc.stormbelt.2: The Tempest Caverns roar with wind. Clear them.
arc.stormbelt.3: Gale Harbor needs Stormwood to rebuild its piers.
arc.stormbelt.4: Nessa Gale waits in the Eye of the Storm.
region.moonwake.name: Moonwake
region.moonwake.desc: Silver waters where dreams drift and foes telegraph their blows.
arc.moonwake.title: The Dreaming Stage
arc.moonwake.0: Night stalkers haunt Echo Atoll. Clear it.
arc.moonwake.1: Dusk Mooring's sailors have fallen asleep. Visit them.
arc.moonwake.2: The Dream Labyrinth shifts with every step. Clear it.
arc.moonwake.3: Lanternport needs Moon Ink to rewrite its charts.
arc.moonwake.4: Orin Lantern holds the Moonwake Stage. Wake him from his dream.
region.ashen_trench.name: Ashen Trench
region.ashen_trench.desc: Crushing depths over sealed ruins that silence skills.
arc.ashen_trench.title: What the Seal Keeps
arc.ashen_trench.0: Relic thieves pick over Sunken Spires. Clear them.
arc.ashen_trench.1: Relic Dock's divers have news. Visit the dock.
arc.ashen_trench.2: The Trench Sanctum hides what the seal keeps. Clear it.
arc.ashen_trench.3: Ashport needs Abyss Alloy to reinforce the seal.
arc.ashen_trench.4: Vale Ash waits at the Ashen Seal. Break through.
region.leviathan_ring.name: Leviathan Ring
region.leviathan_ring.desc: A ring of reefs around a sleeping titan; enemies come in waves.
arc.leviathan_ring.title: Inside the Behemoth
arc.leviathan_ring.0: Ring raiders nest on Bone Reef. Clear them.
arc.leviathan_ring.1: The Migration Post tracks the titan. Visit it.
arc.leviathan_ring.2: The Coral Colossus has woken. Clear it.
arc.leviathan_ring.3: Ringhold needs Leviathan Scale for its sea wall.
arc.leviathan_ring.4: Brakka Reef waits in the Ring Arena.
region.grand_horizon.name: Grand Horizon
region.grand_horizon.desc: The last sea, where only elite crews survive.
arc.grand_horizon.title: The Strongest Captain
arc.grand_horizon.0: Gate duelists guard Zenith Cay. Defeat them.
arc.grand_horizon.1: The Conclave Harbor invites you. Answer the summons.
arc.grand_horizon.2: The Compass Vault holds the way to the final trial. Clear it.
arc.grand_horizon.3: Horizon Gate needs Horizon Glass for the final beacon.
arc.grand_horizon.4: Aurelia Dawn, the reigning champion, waits at the Horizon Arena.
